title: Improved interior layout and cupholders
summary: This topic centers on comments about updated interior features and controls, with a few clearly positive mentions of improved cupholder and layout usability but many fragments that are too vague to determine sentiment confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise updated features, improved cupholder adjustability, and clearer layout or control usability compared with earlier vehicles.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention interior improvement, cramped space, rear-seat tightness, or better entertainment and controls, but the fragments are too brief or context-limited to classify reliably.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined and are too short to establish clear sentiment.
The cluster combines several interior-related subjects, including ingress/egress, seat space, controls, entertainment functions, layout, and cupholders, rather than one single coherent issue.
Some fragments use similar templated wording about what could be improved, which limits detail about the specific customer experience.
